question: Inside the unchanged original initial-q/L RGB96, does an identified intended-end material region of the selected pallet have visible support, and does identified support have a foreign object in front? These are separate nonexclusive local support variables, not native-point D/E/S, whole-crop pallet presence, or point owner.
input_invariants: All original rows, native0..7, WOOD/SQUARE goal and UNKNOWN/input-U remain.
Never recenter on a GT/reference point, change q/L/crop sampling, infer native permutation from nearest GT, or replace an ambiguous selected instance with a convenient pallet.
Use exact float64 q+((index+.5)/96-.5)*L; source integer pixels contribute only with positive four-tap bilinear weight; preserve half-pixel crop-domain and invalid mass.
Original native D/E/S, center owner, nominal/reference coordinates, quality labels and all past annotations remain independent immutable fields.
No new source asset/NPZ/RGB/depth/mask/mesh/weight/GT body is opened during preparation. No evaluation/current/held/VAL or V112 access.

selected_part_correspondence.meaning: A declared constructive source association or direct RGB structural observation connects this original slot's intended local end neighborhood to the same selected instance. An entire board/other end/arbitrary wood surface is insufficient. q8 box, obj_id1, nominal projection and whole-instance mask alone do not establish this association.
selected_part_correspondence.candidate_uncertainty: If several intended-end candidates remain, record all. A conservative enclosure can be used without a pixel-exact mask only if its structural authority and all plausible intended-end candidates are explicit; bbox overlap alone proves no positive support.

visible_positive.test: At least one directly observed selected intended-end material witness contributes positive weight to original RGB96. A selected part may be visible away from q even when center owner is background/foreign. No minimum area or score threshold is tuned.

external_positive_constructive.test: At the same positive-weight raw pixel, target-alone intended patch is supported and a distinct foreign first surface is finite, positive and strictly nearer. Use paired pixel conjunction, never the product of aggregate marginal probabilities.

external_positive_RGB_weak.test: A localized intended-part witness, selected structure continuing behind the distinct foreground object, and observed front ordering jointly support a weak local obstruction observation. Mere foreign presence, mask exclusion, sensor residual, or a nearby arbitrary wood patch is insufficient. This is assistant/source weak evidence, not pixel-exact hidden material or native physical gold.

negative.test: Existence negatives require explicitly supported exhaustive coverage of the intended candidate set, not failure to find a sparse positive. If no selected-end opportunity is certified inside crop, visible may be NO but foreign remains UNKNOWN. A coarse pilot bbox that only bounds one observed fragment cannot certify absence of the whole intended region.

authority_levels.CONSTRUCTIVE_SOURCE_DECLARED: Registered synthetic finite-raster/part/paired-source truth. Original CF/canonical association, not new initializer physical-native certification.
authority_levels.RGB_SELECTED_PART_WEAK: Direct observed material and structural selected-part/instance association; can support source weak visible supervision without demanding perfect mesh/pose registration.
authority_levels.RGB_OCCLUSION_CONTINUATION_WEAK: Direct localized structural continuation plus distinct foreground ordering; weak external support, not native E or hidden pixel/material gold.
authority_levels.RGB_COMPLETE_SELECTED_PART_WEAK: Explicit exhaustive intended-candidate observation for negative support; do not infer this from crop-any-pallet presence or a single box.
authority_levels.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Nominal render/full/vismask, source sensor residual, bbox overlap and model/SAM proposal alone are diagnostic; do not silently become part witness labels. Existing semantic classification remains valid under its own original authority and is not blocked by a new demand for perfect physical registration.

target_rules: Visible=YES when a supported visible witness has positive sampled mass; foreign=YES when a supported foreign-front witness has positive mass. Separate region portions may give BOTH YES. Otherwise each target stays UNKNOWN unless its explicit exhaustive absence condition is supported. Input unavailable/missing q/L or unresolved selected-part correspondence forces both UNKNOWN. Preserve unknown and invalid masses; no renormalization, guessed negatives, or all-known-row filtering.
next_safe_action: Root first freezes the exact SOURCE_TRAIN population and correspondence/evidence schema, then allows a source-only original-RGB structural witness pilot over the original unchanged crops. Record positive material/continuation witnesses and explicit UNKNOWNs with authority, including all slots and candidate alternatives. Measure original96 footprint overlap with those actual witnesses. Keep nominal mesh/sensor diagnostics separate; a future separately approved source builder can consume the weak/source witness sidecar after metadata and pixel-fidelity checks. No pose fitting or perfect-registration certification is required merely to retain existing semantic labels or well-supported RGB weak observations.
